answer_1.quote: Text Style Transfer can be thought of as a form of Controllable Language Generation...
answer_1.outputs: style-transferred sentences (e.g., sentiment polarity changes or discourse manipulation)

answer_2.quote: Typically, metrics for style transfer include Style Transfer Accuracy (using a pretrained classifier), BLEU for content preservation, and perplexity (using a pretrained LM)... For fluency, we use the 'Naturalness' metric... Apart from using BLEU for content preservation, we also report METEOR... ROUGE-L...

answer_4.quote: Three volunteers were given the task of voting on 200 instances... A vote consists of four options...
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers compared outputs for discourse style transfer (Entailment to Contradiction and vice versa) by voting on which model performed better or if both were good/bad.
